# Reaves Dental Practice

> Full-service family and cosmetic dental practice in New Hartford and Utica, NY offering preventive care, restorative treatments, implants, and orthodontics.

Reaves Dental Practice, led by Dr. Justin Reaves, serves the New Hartford and Utica communities with comprehensive dental services ranging from pediatric dentistry to advanced cosmetic and restorative procedures. The practice specializes in both traditional and laser-based treatments including Invisalign, dental implants, and frenectomy procedures.
